title: Publications
description: Journal and conference papers as structured fields; each generator formats them its own way. Fields not listed here are allowed and ignored by the resume generator. The resume build also checks what a schema cannot: ids are unique, month_end is after month, and the owner is among each item's authors.

schema.description: Version of this format. A reader rejects a version it does not know.

owner.description: The person the file belongs to, exactly as the name appears in authors.

text.description: One line of text: not empty, no control character, no leading or trailing whitespace.

id.description: Stable key, <short venue>-<year>-<first author family name>; never changes once written.

authors.description: Paper order; full names when known.

short.description: Short name such as JSSC or ISSCC.

month_end.description: Last month of a multi-month issue; only with month, and after it.
